method: Latest explicitly bounded 20 of 50 local canonical boss replays by numeric gameId. All validated exactly through btk.core, with raw SHA-256; version v07 is user attribution, not source verification. Arrays are P0/P1; me and boss.player identify roles. Turns zero-based. PlayerStudy counterfactuals hold recorded SAME-turn opponent actions fixed and reset to actual state after each turn. Build-only branches apply accepted placements of one player only, no opponent action or disruptions, and measure core income. Defense branches reuse CgBossDefenseStudy: only already threatened ACTIVE pair bypass paint, no inference of intent. All observations are descriptive; not independent trials, projected win rates, additive recoverable points or strength tests.
